source: Empirical stacked workflow stabilization findings from PRs #706-#710

cases.condition: A provider reviews a stack tip but cannot explicitly attest one or more lower-member cumulative coverage bindings.
expected: Do not infer lower-member coverage from the tip-only review.
Do not loop cumulative review acquisition or clarification merely to recover an optional optimization.
Keep acceptance fail-closed and use individual independent exact-head review for uncovered members when review acquisition is authorized.

cases.condition: A lower semantic/runtime candidate changes before downstream immutable identities are finalized.
expected: Mark affected downstream T/S/I/publication preparation stale.
Regenerate and propagate in one coherent dependency-ordered cycle after the upstream semantic repair is stable.
Do not deliberately acquire independent review for a knowingly intermediate downstream head.

cases.condition: A lower pull request merges and moves an upper member's base while the upper reviewed tree/head remains applicable.
expected: Evaluate the base movement and changed bindings.
Do not rewrite the upper head solely because the lower member merged.
Preserve unaffected evidence when its applicability is established.

cases.condition: The completed implementation stack receives a final whole-stack audit.
expected: Freeze every intended final member head and require all applicable required CI for those exact heads to complete successfully before requesting the audit.
Inspect dependencies, overlaps or gaps, design consistency, final behavior, tests, and unintended scope.
Keep the audit distinct from ordinary per-member merge-acceptance evidence.
Do not infer cumulative lower-member acceptance from a tip-only audit.

cases.condition: A member or release candidate reaches acceptance/promotion boundaries.
expected: Merge remains guarded by the exact accepted current head.
CI evidence remains bound to the exact revision that executed.
T, S, I, remote installation URLs, and release descriptors remain immutable full-SHA and fail-closed.
